environment.description: Ktor microservice running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) with NAT gateway providing outbound internet access. The task role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::order-processing-prod/*. S3 traffic routes through the NAT gateway to the public S3 endpoint. No XML processing restrictions at the infrastructure level. Security group allows all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports).

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, outbound 0.0.0.0/0 allowed
config.dns_resolution: VPC default resolver, can resolve external hostnames
